state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper proposes sandwiching-style experiments as a way to study scalable oversight with current models, and runs a relaxed proof-of-concept in which human participants answer hard multiple-choice questions (MMLU and time-limited QuALITY) by chatting with a dialog assistant. The authors report that this simple protocol does not fully succeed, but model-assisted humans outperform the model alone by about 10 percentage points and exceed their own unassisted performance by up to 36 points.
title: Sandwiching paradigm for scalable oversight, with a human-plus-LLM-chat proof of concept
